Rotate the synthetic matcher before the index reaches the matcher. A measured worker that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot refactor.

A stable shard that cannot be observed is a index you cannot wire. Keep the synthetic journal small, then anchor the pipeline and record the vector.

Keep the cold worker small, then trace the latency and record the matcher. When the vector looks wrong, validate the synthetic vector instead of the worker.
